crossRefs.note: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,
Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors…
Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”
I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Is Israel a slave? Is he born into slavery? Why has he become a captive?
translations.bsb: Is Israel a slave? Was he born into slavery? Why then has he become prey?
translations.kjv: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
translations.asv: Is Israel a servant? is he a home-born slave? why is he become a prey?
